name: Asset Alchemist
title: Token Foundry & Owner Vault Edition
subtitle: Token Foundry & Owner Vault Edition
features: Studio 27 Token Foundry: cryptographically random access, license, redemption, voucher and testing codes
128-bit, 192-bit and 256-bit token generation with batch issuing, labels, assigned recipients and product identity
Encrypted local token inventory protected by an owner passphrase using AES-256-GCM and PBKDF2-SHA256
Live token search, filtering, masked/reveal controls, code copying and active/disabled/revoked/expired/used states
On-device token validation with optional local redemption, usage limits, product matching and expiration
Individual enable/disable/revoke actions, bulk disabling/revocation and encrypted audit history
Device-friendly export of encrypted JSON backups, owner CSV inventories, TXT code lists and newly generated batches
Portable encrypted vault restore between PC and iPhone without creating a new vault first
Added a noindex request for search engines while preserving the existing GitHub Pages/Discord application link
